等.meaning: At the <part>temple</part> fair, a monk lists everything for sale on a strip of <part>bamboo</part>: brooms, bells, buns, bowls, beads... The list runs out of room, so he scratches three little dots at the end. That means <kanji>etc.</kanji>
等.on: He drops the bamboo strip on his <sound>toe</sound> and adds one more item: bandages.
等.kun: <sound>He</sound> piles buns on <sound>to</sound>p of the scales until both sides match: equal.

草.meaning: A greedy goat sets its alarm clock for <part>early</part> every morning, sneaks into the neighbour's garden and nibbles each tuft of <part>grass</part> before anyone wakes. By breakfast the lawn is bare, but by evening it has all grown back. It's magic <kanji>grass</kanji>.
草.on: The neighbour scrubs the goat's muddy hooves with a bar of <sound>soa</sound>p.
草.kun: A <sound>cu</sound>ckoo flies down and <sound>su</sound>cks up a long blade like spaghetti.

提.meaning: A sailor drops his ship's <part>anchor</part> in the harbour, angled <part>just so</part>, right in front of his sweetheart's window. Tied to its chain is a ring. He kneels on deck and shouts up to her: he's come to <kanji>propose</kanji>.
提.on: The ring is stuck to the anchor with sticky <sound>ta</sound>pe.
提.kun: She leans out in her best silk <sound>sa</sound>ri and lowers a basket on a rope for the ring.

児.meaning: In a museum of <part>old times</part>, an ancient stone doll on a shelf suddenly sprouts two wobbly <part>legs</part>, toddles to the edge and wails for milk. The guards panic and fetch a bottle. It's a <kanji>newborn babe</kanji>.
児.on: They rush it to hospital in a muddy <sound>jee</sound>p.
児.kun: It falls asleep in the back, hugging a toy <sound>ko</sound>ala.

遺.meaning: An old pirate rolls a chest of <part>precious</part> pearls down the <part>ramp</part> of his ship to his parrot. 'When I'm gone, it's all yours.' The parrot squawks and starts writing a will on the deck in feathers. Everything he owns, he will <kanji>bequeath</kanji>.
遺.on: The cat gets just one jar of pickled <sound>ee</sound>l.
遺.kun: '<sound>No</sound>t the <sound>ko</sound>ala,' he adds. 'That one stays behind with me.'

逆.meaning: An <part>uprooted sprout</part> rolls down a <part>ramp</part> head over heels and lands with its leaves in the soil and its roots waving in the air. It likes it that way and grows up the wrong way round, apples at the bottom. It's a tree <kanji>inverted</kanji>.
逆.on: A goat takes one bite of an upside-down apple and spits it out with a bi<sound>g</sound> '<sound>Yuck</sound>!'
逆.kun: The tree's story becomes a long <sound>sa</sound>ga, told by a <sound>ca</sound>rp in the pond below.

柄.meaning: A lodger in a cheap <part>third class</part> cabin is bored, so he carves the wooden <part>tree</part> of a bedpost into swirls, leaves and little owls. Soon every passenger wants a look. The poorest cabin on the ship has the finest <kanji>design</kanji>.
柄.on: His mattress is just a sack of <sound>hay</sound>, but he even carves patterns into that.
柄.kun: A <sound>gu</sound>ll pecks at the swirls through the porthole and caws '<sound>Rah</sound>!'

答.meaning: A class racks its brains over a puzzle box with no key. One girl snaps off a stick of <part>bamboo</part> and whittles it until it slides into the keyhole with a perfect <part>fit</part>. Click: the lid pops. She's found the <kanji>solution</kanji>.
答.on: Inside is a tiny wooden <sound>toe</sound>, which makes no sense at all.
答.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala in the back row shouts the answer through a mouthful of <sound>ta</sound>co.
